name: The Ridgeway
description_md:
The Ridgeway is a waymarked hiking route in GB that spans 138.9 km. This hard route requires about 40 hours of walking time according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The trail is part of a national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as RW. It features 2138 m of ascent and 2197 m of descent. The route passes Avebury Stone Circle within 1800 m, Avebury Tourist Information Centre within 1900 m, and Avebury and Associated Monuments within 1900 m.
